changes.reason: Validate test plan command arguments before reading Git or local artifacts. The change is confined to CLI dispatch and option parsing.

kubernetes.reason: The Node CLI validates its own command line outside the application Host. Parsing requires no Kubernetes capabilities, storage, or lifecycle hooks.

aws-lambda.reason: CLI argument validation does not run on the Lambda invocation path or interact with Lambda bindings, storage, or lifecycle hooks.

cloudflare.reason: CLI argument validation does not run in a Workers or Container Host and uses no Cloudflare bindings, storage, or lifecycle hooks.
